handmadeStandards.title: Normas de lo hecho a mano
handmadeStandards.intro: Oddkeeps revisa a quienes hacen y a los anuncios antes de que un producto pueda mostrar la insignia de hecho a mano verificado. Quien vende no puede conceder esa insignia.
handmadeStandards.makerBody: Quien hace cuenta a Oddkeeps quien es y como trabaja. Oddkeeps revisa esa declaracion antes de certificar productos.
handmadeStandards.productBody: Cada producto certificado tiene su propia revision. Oddkeeps mira la declaracion, el metodo de produccion y la descripcion publica. La insignia aparece solo cuando la revision esta aprobada y sigue vigente.
handmadeStandards.partnerBody: Algunas piezas las disena quien hace y las produce un socio nombrado. Oddkeeps revisa a ese socio antes de que esos anuncios muestren la insignia. La clasificacion publica indica cuando participo un socio.
handmadeStandards.resaleBody: La insignia no es para revender articulos que quien vende no hizo, diseno o transformo de forma significativa. Los productos industriales presentados como hechos a mano no pueden llevarla.
handmadeStandards.reportBody: Si un anuncio no coincide con lo declarado, usa Informar una duda de autenticidad en la pagina del producto. El informe llega a Confianza y seguridad. Las pruebas privadas y las notas de revision se quedan en Oddkeeps.

faq.title: Before you apply
faq.help: Something else on your mind? Write to us at

who.question: Who can sell on {marketplace}?
who.answer: Independent makers and small teams who design and make their own work. You can apply as an individual or as a business.

account.question: Do I need an account to apply?
account.answer: You can start your application with just your email address. To submit it for review, sign in or create a free account. Your draft is kept while you sign in.

review.question: How does the review work?
review.answer: A member of our team reads every application and looks at your photographs and making process. We email you when a decision is made, or if we need more detail.

cost.question: What does it cost to sell?
cost.answer: Applying is free. Selling fees and payout terms are explained before your shop goes live, so you know exactly what to expect.

after.question: What happens after I am approved?
after.answer: We email you an invitation to set up your seller account. You then add your shop details and products. Products are reviewed before buyers can see them.

changes.question: What if the team asks for changes?
changes.answer: You update the same application with the details we asked for and submit it again. You do not need to start over.

again.question: Can I apply more than once?
again.answer: Each email address can have one seller application. If your application was not approved and you have questions, contact us before applying under another email.

closing.title: Ready to open your shop?
closing.body: Applying is free and your progress is saved as you go. We will be in touch by email once our team has reviewed your application.

apply.intro: Five short steps. Your progress is saved after each one, so you can stop and come back later.
